description: App windows. The app's own #[tauri::command]s (daemon_connect/send/disconnect, file_size/file_read, log_forward, pref_*, registry_*, window_open/focus) are allowed by default and need no permission string; the daemon-stream Channel rides core IPC covered by core:default. Child windows (detached-*, project-*) load the same renderer and need the same core IPC, plus core:window self-close/start-dragging for their own chrome.
